scenarios.title: Current eligibility with unchanged Assessment Date and relevant field changes uses Maintenance Date
gaps: Test Case Name field 'Verify AR PASSE current eligibility uses the Maintenance Date for a relevant field change without changing Assessment Date and preserves full finance-sensitive processing trail' is broader than any one numbered entry, while scenario description requires distinct coverage for 'Conditions to cover: 1) Assessment Number changes while Assessment Date is unchanged. 2) Assessment Tier changes while Assessment Date is unchanged. 3) Assessment Division changes while Assessment Date is unchanged. 4) Aid Category changes while Assessment Date is unchanged. 5) Rate Cell changes while Assessment Date is unchanged. 6) Pregnancy changes while Assessment Date is unchanged. 7) Assessment Number, Assessment Tier and Assessment Division change together while Assessment Date is unchanged. 8) All relevant fields change together while Assessment Date is unchanged. 9) Multiple occurrences of Maintenance Date = Loop 2000 DTP*303 are present and the first occurrence is used as the transaction effective date.'

Domain hint contradiction in Pre-condition: "An update 834 test member exists with a valid member SSN in NM109, and the tester can prepare one AR PASSE daily file containing an Eligibility Date in Loop 2000 DTP*356 or DTP*348, an Assessment Date in Loop 2300 HD03, and a Maintenance Date in Loop 2000 DTP*303." contradicts hint "Coverage follows the programme's manual matrix for this story: (Assessment Date changed vs not changed) x (existing member vs future eligibility) x relevant-field variations - including MULTI-FIELD COMBINATIONS as their own conditions (e.g. Assessment Number + Tier + Division together, and an All Relevant Fields Updated condition per quadrant)." because condition 1 requires Effective Date recognition, not an Eligibility-Date path

Coverage gap for TC_003: scenario also requires "Coverage follows the programme's manual matrix for this story: (Assessment Date changed vs not changed) x (existing member vs future eligibility) x relevant-field variations - including MULTI-FIELD COMBINATIONS as their own conditions (e.g. Assessment Number + Tier + Division together, and an All Relevant Fields Updated condition per quadrant). Coverage gap for TC_004: scenario also requires "Coverage follows the programme's manual matrix for this story: (Assessment Date changed vs not changed) x (existing member vs future eligibility) x relevant-field variations - including MULTI-FIELD COMBINATIONS as their own conditions (e.g. Assessment Number + Tier + Division together, and an All Relevant Fields Updated condition per quadrant).
